title: Pythagoras' theorem and trigonometry
summary: Pythagoras' theorem in 2D and 3D, the three trig ratios (SOH CAH TOA), finding sides and angles, elevation, depression and bearings.

cards.title: Pythagoras' theorem
cards.rule: In a right-angled triangle: \(c^2 = a^2 + b^2\). \(c\) is the hypotenuse, the longest side.

cards.title: Finding a shorter side
cards.rule: To find a shorter side, subtract: \(a^2 = c^2 - b^2\).
cards.tip: a shorter side can never be longer than the hypotenuse.

cards.title: Pythagoras in 2D problems
cards.rule: Draw it, mark the right angle, then find the triangle.
lines: A 5 m ladder reaches 4 m up a wall: the foot is \(\sqrt{25 - 16} = 3\) m out

cards.title: Pythagoras in 3D
cards.rule: Find a right triangle on one face first, then use that length in a second triangle.

cards.title: Trigonometric ratios
cards.rule: SOH CAH TOA. Label the sides from the angle you're using.

cards.title: Finding unknown sides
cards.rule: Pick the ratio that uses the side you know and the side you want.

cards.title: Solving for the denominator
cards.rule: When \(x\) is on the bottom, swap it with the trig value.
cards.tip: check the answer makes sense: the hypotenuse must be the longest side.

cards.title: Applying trigonometry
cards.rule: Angles of elevation (looking up) and depression (looking down) are measured from the horizontal.
lines: 20 m from a tree, the angle of elevation to the top is 32°
cards.tip: draw the horizontal line first, then the angle.

cards.title: Bearings
cards.rule: True bearings are measured clockwise from north, with three digits.
lines: Walk 10 km on 060°T: east \(10\sin 60^\circ \approx 8.66\) km, north \(10\cos 60^\circ = 5\) km
